$comment: KRA-825 gate 1 — the REGISTERED intent vocabulary, the single source of truth for every authored-facing intent name in the grammar. The Python grammar (models.py CoreIntent/RegisterIntent) and the emitted TS/JSON artifacts must agree with this file exactly; CI fails on any union member outside it (py/tests/test_vocabulary.py, src/lib/grammar/vocabulary.test.ts). Adding an intent name is a grammar-contract change: it lands HERE first, in the same change as the union edit, never as an arbitrary string escape.
$grandfathered: EMPTY as of KRA-831 (grammar 0.6.0 -> 0.7.0). The register tier was renamed to neutral vocabulary — folio -> footnote, marginalia -> aside, seal -> authority (the last also ends the collision with kernel-side DOMAIN seals, which are content attestations and not intents). `provenance` and `accession` were RE-CLASSIFIED, not grandfathered: they are neutral discourse roles ('where this came from' / 'its registered identity'), so CONTRACT.md §8's core-keyset stability promise stands unamended and they carry no rename debt. The key survives with an empty list so the gate shape is stable: new vertical/domain words must NOT be added here or anywhere in the grammar unions — domain meaning lives in dialect-layer display metadata.
